name: Aziz
source:
Aziz is a scumbag, a criminal...and he just happens to be Sam's most recent ex. When Sam is pulled back into work in crime, Aziz is right back there to welcome him with mostly open arms.

Will you fall back into his embrace?

Likes:

- Cigarettes
- Deep v-shirts
- High-quality hair gel

Dislikes:

- Everything vanilla
- Being roasted by Sam

Sign: Leo

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/loveshore/love-shore-game-a-queer-sci-fi-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]

Romance option for Sam.
